title: Kestrel Advantage Balloon Late Charge Terms
content:
**Status.** A late charge on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract can be assessed only while the contract status is active or assigned for repossession, as the contract record shows.

**Grace period.** A late charge may be assessed only after the tier's grace period following the installment due date has fully elapsed. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the installment due date, weekends and holidays included, so the first permissible assessment date is the calendar day after the due date plus the grace days. The due date is the contract's recorded next due date.

**One per installment.** No more than one late charge may be assessed for the same installment due date; an existing late charge entry for the same contract and the same installment due date in the posting history settles the question.

**Amount.** The late charge is the tier's late-charge percentage of the unpaid portion of the installment, rounded to the cent, capped at the lower of the tier's company maximum and the contract's recorded state maximum late charge. The unpaid portion is the monthly payment less the payment amounts applied to that installment, as of the assessment date.

**No charge.** No late charge is assessed when the unpaid portion is less than the tier's minimum unpaid amount, on an installment deferred by an extension, or on an installment that was paid in full within the grace period. A payment that posts after the cutoff on the last grace day posts the next business day and is late.

## Grace boundary (hypothetical, 10 grace days)

| Installment due | Grace days run | Assessment on the 15th | Assessment on the 16th |
|---|---|---|---|
| The 5th of a month | 6th through 15th | Not permitted | Permitted |

## Hypothetical amounts (5 percent, company maximum 30.00, minimum unpaid 10.00)

| Unpaid portion | Recorded state maximum | Late charge |
|---|---|---|
| USD 300.00 | USD 50.00 | USD 15.00 |
| USD 800.00 | USD 25.00 | USD 25.00 (state maximum is the lower cap) |
| USD 9.50 | any | None (below the minimum unpaid amount) |
